payload.claim: `checkout_ref = stacked_on or base_sha` treats any falsy `stacked_on` the same as `None`, even though the field is typed `str | None` and a present-but-empty string is a different condition from absence. No caller today can produce that value (every caller passes a real 40-char sha or `None`), so nothing currently breaks, but the pattern silently substitutes the fallback base rather than surfacing a malformed value — exactly the kind of absence-vs-presence conflation `SA-0025`, which resolves a real parent onto this exact field, will inherit unless it is deliberately re-examined then.
